messages:
Iris Coleman: ticket #4120 1customer reports being charged twice when their streaming call retried; they included a client resume token in the retry but it still appears as a separate ledger row.
Tom H: did the client include any idempotency/session header or a resume-token in the first place?
Iris Coleman: yes, client-supplied `Resume-Token: r-9a3f` on the retry. original stream didn't have it (old client), new client reconnected and sent the resume token. both regions show provisional grants.
Yasmin Rao: interesting edge: the resume token was client-generated but only present on the retry, so region B had no context for the original provisional grants from region A. we currently associate provisional grants to the local route and only reconcile on explicit `segment.confirm` events.
Eli (billing): finance notes: refunds are allowed if we can prove duplicate billing. we need a deterministic reconcile path. any heuristics we add must be auditable.
Nate (console): support is asking for a dashboard affordance: show "related provisional rows" for a given ledger row (based on fingerprinting) and a fast path to request billing ops review. could be a drawer that surfaces telemetry links + candidate duplicates.
Tom H: telemetry idea: emit `stream.resume.attempt` with fields `{customer_id, resume_token, trace_id, route_id, prompt_hash_prefix}` and `stream.grant.segment` include `segment_checksum` and `lease_id`. that'll help match cross-route replays.
Yasmin Rao: we can add `segment_checksum` by hashing the first N tokens of the segment + prompt salt. high entropy so collisions are unlikely. use it only for offline reconcile (not customer-visible).
Iris Coleman: what about a short-term server-side heuristic: if a resume_token is presented on a retry and matches a later confirmed segment checksum from another route within 90s, mark the earlier provisional as stale and flag for refund?
Eli (billing): be careful: if toolcall was involved, we cannot auto-flag. require `toolcall.invoked=false` and `customer_ack=false`. also any auto-refund needs an audit record and legal approval.
Nate (console): UI approach: highlight provisional rows with a pulsing badge and an action "Find related provisional rows" that runs fingerprint heuristics and shows candidates with confidence scores (high/medium/low). support can escalate high-confidence ones to billing ops.
Tom H: longer-term: server-side session handoff / lease transfer: when router hands off to another route we could push a `lease_transfer` event so the new route knows about provisional grants and won't re-grant for overlapping offsets. but that requires maintaining short-lived global session state (redis or control-plane ink).
Yasmin Rao: that'd fix the CDN rebalancing case but adds complexity. maybe implement lease-transfer for Dedicated customers first where we have sticky sessions.
Iris Coleman: also quota interaction: some customers hit quota on retry which caused the retry to route to a cheaper model variant and that variant's grants used a different billing SKU. support saw two different model_ids on ledger row which made it look like two separate calls.
Eli (billing): record model_variant and route_id on provisional grants for clarity. finance likes explicit metadata.
Nate (console): action list I can pick up: (1) add provisional badge + "find related" action (ETA 3d small patch), (2) show `route_id` and `model_variant` in ledger row details (ETA 2d).
Tom H: infra/telem: I'll add `stream.resume.attempt` and `segment_checksum` to grant events, and include `lease_id` when available. low-risk change.
Yasmin Rao: I'll prototype a reconcile worker that consumes these events and emits `reconcile.suggestion` with a confidence score. it will not auto-apply refunds, just populate the console drawer for ops review. ETA EOW for a rough prototype.
Eli (billing): I'll start a legal/finance check on refund policy for these suggestions; we need signoff before any auto-refund.
ops-bot: reminder: add reconcile.suggestion demo to next oncall agenda.
Iris Coleman: I'll update the customer: explain provisional grants are per-route, we're adding console tooling to surface likely duplicates and a telemetry-backed reconcile path. offer manual billing ops review in the meantime.
Nate (console): I'll drop a Figma mock and open a small PR after design review. link: https://figma.redwood/reconcile-drawer (WIP).
Tom H: leaving this thread open until telemetry events + console drawer PR land.
Iris Coleman: assigning ticket to eng-platform + billing ops.
